test_name: System and Services Acquisition - SA-10 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Data-Exchange-166
Primary NIST family: System and Services Acquisition (SA); evidence focus: SA-10.
Environment: GCP. Network access uses Private Service Connect; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Cloud KMS key. Control evidence: developer configuration management tracks approved changes and security impact. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
